pr_title: feat(fill): allow filling based on the label selector
pr_body:
This enables filling the input based on the connected label:

```html
<label for=target>Name</label><input id=target>
```

```js
await page.fill('text=Name', 'Alice');
```

Fixes #3466.
pr_comments: Lets maybe add it to the docs if it was not possible before to fill by label text?

> Lets maybe add it to the docs if it was not possible before to fill by label text?

Good idea, done.

issue_context.title: [Feature] Fill input field based on label text
issue_context.body:
When an input field is properly connected to a label it would be nice to be able to fill the input field based on the label text using `await page.fill('text=Name', 'John Doe');`.

It's often possible to fill the input field based on a CSS selector like `id` or `name`, but making it possible to fill by label text would make it more straight-forward to both read and write the test. Especially if you write tests for screens you did not make yourself.

Examples of cases where it should work:
```
<label for="input1">Name</label>
<input id="input1" value="">
```

```
<label>Name <input value=""></label>

```
comments:
i think in general `label=` could be a nice selector strategy.
I would feel comfortable to mix it with general Text selector, because then it would be possible anymore to select the <label> tag itself with the "Text" selector.

i would also not limit it to <input> fields!
Labels can be used on:
```
<input>
<meter>
<progress>
<select>
<textarea>
```

review_comments: This means I can't click a label if it is missing a `for`? But in that case shouldn't we just click the label itself.
